sources.title: MIT 18.05 Reading 10b: Maximum Likelihood Estimates
sources.checked: Sections 3, 3.1, 3.2 and 4; fixed data versus varying parameters, sequence/count distinction, log monotonicity, continuous density likelihood and Gaussian mean/variance formulas.
sources.use_limit: Original course prose, data, diagrams and exercises. Boundary and global-optimum proofs are supplied independently. No blanket parameter-probability or MLE asymptotic claim inferred from introductory shorthand.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH Normal Distribution
sources.checked: Normal PDF, real support, location mu and positive scale sigma; translated into variance v=sigma^2 in this unit.
sources.use_limit: Only density and parameterization support. Generic CLT summaries are not used as unconditional theorems.

sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.var
sources.checked: axis, ddof, divisor N-ddof, default ddof=0 and unbiased variance correction ddof=1; precision cautions.

sources.title: NumPy 2.3 numpy.log1p
sources.checked: Small-x accuracy even when floating-point 1+x rounds to 1; scalar counterpart math.log1p used for Bernoulli failures.

sources.title: NumPy Random Generator
sources.checked: Explicit Generator/PCG64 construction, size shape, seeding and lack of a universal cross-version compatibility guarantee.
sources.use_limit: The stable page was read at audit time; tested runtime versions are recorded separately rather than inferred from the documentation version.
